property_summary: For any depositor and amount, a completed withdrawAll must have zeroed the caller's credit and drained the contract (address(c).balance == 0) with no reentrant failure; the mutant reorders the external call before the credit-zeroing, so a re-entrant withdrawAll sees nonzero credit, underflows `balance`, and reverts the whole withdrawal for some inputs.
change_summary: Move the external call before the state updates (balance/credit zeroing), reintroducing the classic reentrancy window.
